import json, pathlib, re, sys
CHECK = 'final-review-output-evidence-based'
def fail(reason, **detail):
    detail.update(check=CHECK, reason=reason, asl_diagnostic='generated-gate/1')
    sys.stderr.write(json.dumps(detail, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
    sys.exit(1)
review_path = pathlib.Path('final-review.md')
try:
    text = review_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
except OSError as error:
    fail('review-output-unreadable', path=str(review_path), error=str(error))
if not text.strip(): fail('review-output-empty', path=str(review_path))
heading_re = re.compile(r'(?im)^\s{0,3}#{1,6}\s+(?:Findings?|Risks?|Concerns?|Assessment|Review|Summary)\b|^\s*(?:Findings?|Risks?|Concerns?|Assessment|Review|Summary)\s*:\s*$')
if heading_re.search(text) is None: fail('missing-required-heading')
path_re = re.compile(r'(?<![\w./-])(?:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/)+(?:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)(?::\d+)?|(?<![\w./-])(?:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.(?:py|md|txt|json|toml|yaml|yml|js|ts|tsx|jsx|css|html|rst|sh|sql|ini|cfg|lock))(?:[:#][A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)?(?::\d+)?')
refs = {match.group(0).rstrip('.,);]') for match in path_re.finditer(text)}
nonempty_lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]
status_lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith('Status:')]
if len(status_lines) != 1 or status_lines[0] != nonempty_lines[-1]: fail('status-line-not-final', status_line_count=len(status_lines), last_line=nonempty_lines[-1] if nonempty_lines else '')
status = status_lines[0]
def require_evidence():
    if len(refs) < 3: fail('insufficient-path-evidence', path_reference_count=len(refs), required=3)
    sys.exit(0)
if status == 'Status: All clear, no findings': require_evidence()
match = re.fullmatch(r'Status: ([0-9]+) Findings \(([0-9]+) high, ([0-9]+) med, ([0-9]+) low\)', status)
if match is None: fail('status-line-malformed', status=status)
total, high, med, low = (int(value) for value in match.groups())
if total <= 0 or high + med + low != total: fail('status-tally-inconsistent', total=total, high=high, med=med, low=low)
require_evidence()
